en: come back and play again sometime, okay?

en: I certainly had no intention of landing you down here, but it seems we've found quite the hidden paradise.
ja: ここへ 落とすつもりは なかったが どうやら 隠れた 楽園を 見つけたようだ

key: CAIN: Oh, you were right behind me after all.
en: CAIN: Oh, you were right behind me after all.
ja: カイン: なんだ やっぱり すぐ 後ろに いたんだねぇ

key: But that's not the only thing we found-- look!
en: But that's not the only thing we found-- look!
ja: でも 見つけたのは それだけじゃ ないよ　見て!

key: ???: Oh, so it was true...
en: ???: Oh, so it was true...
ja: ???: ああ やっぱり 本当だったんだ……

key: CAIN: Huh, were you expecting us?
en: CAIN: Huh, were you expecting us?
ja: カイン: へえ ボクたちが 来るって 知ってたの?

key: ???: Not at all!
en: ???: Not at all!

key: But that older man just came through and explained the situation to me.
en: But that older man just came through and explained the situation to me.
ja: でも さっき 年配の男の人が 通りかかって 事情を 説明してくれたんだ

key: I'm quite surprised that there's anyone else down here.
en: I'm quite surprised that there's anyone else down here.
ja: こんな地下に ほかにも 人が いるなんて 驚きだよ

key: RADOMUS: To be clear, exactly what did he tell you?
en: RADOMUS: To be clear, exactly what did he tell you?
ja: ラドマス: 念のため 聞くが 彼は 正確に 何と 言った?

key: ???: He told me how he was on the run from some individuals who kidnapped and brainwashed his daughter?
en: ???: He told me how he was on the run from some individuals who kidnapped and brainwashed his daughter?
ja: ???: 娘を さらって 洗脳した 者たちから 逃げているって 言ってたよ

key: Absolutely deplorable behavior-- I won't abide by it.
en: Absolutely deplorable behavior-- I won't abide by it.
ja: まったく 嘆かわしい 行いだ　見過ごせないね

key: But he had your Gardevoir, and-- Just--
en: But he had your Gardevoir, and-- Just--
ja: でも あの人が きみの サーナイトを 連れてて——というか——

key: Just what have you done to this poor thing?
en: Just what have you done to this poor thing?
ja: この かわいそうな 子に いったい 何を したんだい?

key: RADOMUS: I beg your pardon?
en: RADOMUS: I beg your pardon?
ja: ラドマス: 何と 言った?

key: ???: Your Gardevoir doesn't seem to care for you as a Trainer at all.
en: ???: Your Gardevoir doesn't seem to care for you as a Trainer at all.
ja: ???: きみの サーナイトは トレーナーとしての きみを まったく 慕っていない

en: Isn't that right?

key: GARDEVOIR: ...Yes.
en: GARDEVOIR: ...Yes.
ja: サーナイト: ……ええ

key: I-- had always been too afraid of Radomus to say anything about it, but...
en: I-- had always been too afraid of Radomus to say anything about it, but...
ja: わたし——ずっと ラドマスが こわくて 言えなかったの でも……

key: You'll protect me, won't you, Adrienn?
en: You'll protect me, won't you, Adrienn?
ja: 守って くれるわよね アドリエンヌ?

key: ADRIENN: I'm not going to stand for anyone who treats their Pokémon badly.
en: ADRIENN: I'm not going to stand for anyone who treats their Pokémon badly.
ja: アドリエンヌ: ポケモンを ひどく 扱う人を わたしは 見過ごさないよ

key: You're safe with me, Gardevoir.
en: You're safe with me, Gardevoir.
ja: わたしと一緒なら　もう安心だよ　サーナイト

key: RADOMUS: Oh-ho, so that's how it is.
en: RADOMUS: Oh-ho, so that's how it is.
ja: ラドマス: ほほう、そういうことか。

key: What a pointless gambit.
en: What a pointless gambit.
ja: なんとも無益なガンビットだな。

key: GARDEVOIR: I've always hated being with him!
en: GARDEVOIR: I've always hated being with him!
ja: サーナイト: わたし、ずっとこの人といるのが嫌だったの!

key: CAIN: But back at the Castle, you seemed perfectly happy.
en: CAIN: But back at the Castle, you seemed perfectly happy.
ja: カイン: でもさ、お城じゃ　すごく幸せそうだったじゃない～

key: GARDEVOIR: It was all a show!
en: GARDEVOIR: It was all a show!
ja: サーナイト: 全部お芝居よ!

key: I'm expected to be in perfect harmony with my Trainer--
en: I'm expected to be in perfect harmony with my Trainer--
ja: トレーナーと完全に心を通わせていろと求められる——

key: But how can I, with someone like that?!
en: But how can I, with someone like that?!
ja: でも、あんな人相手にどうしろって言うの?!

key: All the horrible things he's done...
en: All the horrible things he's done...
ja: この人がしてきたひどいこと……

key: He's neglectful and lies all the time...
en: He's neglectful and lies all the time...
ja: ほったらかしにするし、いつもうそばかり……

key: I was even there when he brainwashed Luna!
en: I was even there when he brainwashed Luna!
ja: ルナを洗脳したときだって　わたしはその場にいたのよ!

key: The truth is, I was glad when El stole me away!
en: The truth is, I was glad when El stole me away!
ja: 本当は、エルに連れ出されて　うれしかったの!

key: ADRIENN: There you have it.
en: ADRIENN: There you have it.
ja: アドリエンヌ: そういうことだよ。

key: I can't forgive someone for being so cruel to such a sweet Pokémon as Gardevoir.
en: I can't forgive someone for being so cruel to such a sweet Pokémon as Gardevoir.
ja: サーナイトみたいな優しいポケモンに　こんなひどい仕打ちをする人は許せない。

key: That's why I will definitely protect her!
en: That's why I will definitely protect her!
ja: だから、わたしがこの子を必ず守る!

key: I'll help him get his daughter, and his stolen property back.
en: I'll help him get his daughter, and his stolen property back.
ja: わたしは彼の娘と、盗まれた品を取り戻す手伝いをする。

key: CAIN: Stolen property too? What are you talking about now?
en: CAIN: Stolen property too? What are you talking about now?
ja: カイン: 盗まれた品? 今度は何の話なのさ～

en: GARDEVOIR: \PN must know.

key: After all, she has them.
en: After all, she has them.

key: After all, they have them.
en: After all, they have them.
ja: だって、あの人が持っているんだもの。

key: After all, he has them.
en: After all, he has them.
ja: だって、彼が持っているんだもの。

key: CAIN: \PN stole something? What?
en: CAIN: \PN stole something? What?

en: Gardevoir took the Amethyst Pendant from \PN!
ja: サーナイトは \PNから　アメジストのペンダントを　奪い取った!

key: GARDEVOIR: This! And...
en: GARDEVOIR: This! And...
ja: サーナイト: これ! それに……

key: CAIN: What? No, that Amethyst Pendant is Anna's!
en: CAIN: What? No, that Amethyst Pendant is Anna's!
ja: カイン: 何? 違うよ、そのアメジストのペンダントはアンナのだ!

key: Get off of \PN!
en: Get off of \PN!

en: GARDEVOIR: But there's still the Ruby Ring.

key: These items rightfully belong to El.
en: These items rightfully belong to El.

en: RADOMUS: Sorry, did you mention an 'Amethyst Pendant'?

en: GARDEVOIR: I guess it'll have to do.
ja: サーナイト: これで我慢するしかないわね。

en: Only one key is necessary to reach the aerie, so taking both of them would have been ideal...

en: ADRIENN: People are often slow to part with their belongings, even when they hold them back.
ja: アドリエンヌ: 人は自分の足を引っぱる物でも　なかなか手放せないものだよ。

en: GARDEVOIR: As you say.

key: I'll remember it.
en: I'll remember it.

key: CAIN: That was... strange.

key: You wouldn't really have done that, would you?

key: RADOMUS: And exactly how would I do such a thing?
en: RADOMUS: And exactly how would I do such a thing?

key: That's a foolish idea.

en: Do you want to mine the rock?

en: It seems too sturdy to break or move...

en: Yes
